bull_case: AI power density, liquid cooling, service penetration and microgrid/behind-the-meter power create several independent routes to substantially higher content per data-center build.
bear_case: A capex-cycle reversal plus large-customer bargaining power and acquisition commitments can compress multiples and leave substantial downside despite a good industrial franchise.
thesis: VRT has attractive operating upside but only moderate valuation downside protection. Locked Bull value is roughly 1.9x the cutoff price through multiple growth paths, while Bear value is about one-third of price. Strong cash generation and a globally diversified installed base support residual value, but the stock remains cycle- and multiple-sensitive.

evidence.claim: Year-end 2025 backlog was $15.0B versus $7.2B a year earlier, with most considered firm and expected within 12-18 months.
Q2 Americas, Asia Pacific and EMEA sales were $2.071B, $719.9M and $483.6M, respectively, providing geographic diversification.
Vertiv agreed to acquire UIG to add microgrid controls, switchgear and behind-the-meter power architecture, extending the portfolio from grid interconnect to chip.
At June 30 cash plus short-term investments slightly exceeded net long-term debt before the announced UIG cash consideration.

counterevidence: Large hyperscale and cloud customers have strong bargaining power and can delay/cancel projects.
The $1.45B upfront UIG cash payment reduces balance-sheet downside protection if the deal closes.
Backlog may amplify rather than reduce risk if fixed-price execution or supply constraints deteriorate.
A large portion of the equity value reflects continued AI capex intensity.
unknowns: Backlog by customer and cancellation profile.
Long-run liquid-cooling share and service attach rates.
falsifiers: If book-to-bill/backlog falls sharply while hyperscaler capex slows, upside-path score should decline.
If service/liquid-cooling/microgrid content per project expands faster than expected, Bull value should rise.
A material price decline without fundamental deterioration would improve permanent-loss asymmetry.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is near Base and well below Bull.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Balance-sheet liquidity and cash generation make insolvency risk low; valuation/cycle risk remains but is not disproportionate to upside.

subscores.rationale: Locked Bull/current is about 1.9x with multiple paths through core power/cooling, services and microgrid adjacency.
Locked Bear/current is roughly one-third, indicating meaningful downside despite strong franchise residual value.
Scenario tree separates core backlog conversion, cycle normalization and adjacency/M&A upside, with explicit sensitivity to working capital.

uncertainties.rationale: Several upside paths share exposure to the same AI infrastructure capex cycle.
UIG cash consideration will reduce net liquidity.
The current AI data-center buildout has limited historical analogues at this power density.
